description: Defines the QuicCompressedCertsCache class, a cache for storing compressed certificates in the QUIC protocol implementation, including methods for insertion, retrieval, and cache management.

classes.name: QuicCompressedCertsCache
classes.description: A cache class for storing and retrieving compressed certificates with LRU eviction policy.

methods.name: QuicCompressedCertsCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing cache with maximum number of certificates.

methods.name: GetCompressedCert
methods.description: Retrieves cached compressed certificate if available for given chain and hashes.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a new compressed certificate into the cache.
